scope: Manufacturer evidence for a replacement high-current positive/return GPU-style source assembly meeting the PiSXMe 40 A continuous and 45 A 100 ms design envelope.

candidate_summary.recommended_bounded_prototype_assumption: Samtec PowerStrip/40 PET-08-02-T-VT-LC terminal + PES-08-02-T-VT socket with a PESS 10-AWG cable configuration, energizing exactly one positive and one return position for the first source-envelope screen; Package/Power Authority must confirm geometry and configured cable MPN.
candidate_summary.alternative: Amphenol FCI M-CRPS 10170331-360001, 6-contact, 40 A/contact, 0.6 mOhm max contact record; exact 12-V mating cable and pin parallelization unresolved.
candidate_summary.existing_selection: Molex 0039300020 / 39-30-0020 Mini-Fit Jr., 13 A/contact; inadequate for corrected 40 A positive/return pair.
candidate_summary.samtec_screen: Manufacturer power report after 20 percent derating and at 30 C rise: 48.5 A/contact with two powered contacts; 38.0 A/contact with four; do not parallel four contacts without a new calculation.
